contract.intent: Validate ann-system-design against the now-locked functional-spec: every component must serve at least one function (F1-F17), every function must map to components, and the component shape must not contradict the settled flow decisions (gate interaction model, run-next/specify-task convergence). Produce a conformance report; if anything mis-shapes, amend via the change protocol (complete superseding artifact).
acceptanceCriteria: Conformance report artifact exists at artifacts/conformance-report.md
Function → component coverage: every F1-F17 maps to at least one component; every component serves at least one function (no orphans)
Component shape checked against functional-spec §2/§3 (gate talk-loop, pull/push convergence, validate-as-idea-gate, card=gate①)
Deviations listed with severity (error blocks the build; warning is advisory); errors route to a change-protocol amendment of ann-system-design
Report locked or folded into an amendment; findings recorded as evidence events
